note: This list is a starting point, not an exhaustive directory, and focuses on schools of like conviction. We include only schools that publicly affirm the fundamentals of the historic Christian faith. Because a school's doctrine and spiritual climate can change over time, and because CHESS does not control these institutions, families must personally verify each school's current statement of faith — and confirm that a faithful, Bible-believing local church is within reach — before enrolling.

colleges.name: Chambers College
colleges.note: Affiliated with Reformation Baptist Church and led by Pastor Baxter Ong. A natural next step for many CHESS families, rooted in the same convictions.

colleges.name: Bob Jones University (BJU)
colleges.note: A long-standing fundamentalist university holding to biblical inerrancy and the deity of Christ.

colleges.name: Maranatha Baptist University (MBU)
colleges.note: An independent Baptist university committed to the inerrancy of Scripture and historic Baptist doctrine.

colleges.name: Reformation Bible College (RBC)
colleges.note: A Reformed college grounded in the authority and inerrancy of Scripture and the historic doctrines of grace.

colleges.name: The Master's University
colleges.note: Associated with Grace Community Church and Pastor John MacArthur; strong commitment to the authority and inerrancy of Scripture.

colleges.name: Boyce College
colleges.note: The undergraduate college of The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary, grounded in confessional, conservative theology.

colleges.name: Patrick Henry College
colleges.note: Founded with homeschool graduates in mind; affirms biblical inerrancy and a classical, Christ-centered liberal arts education.

colleges.name: Grove City College
colleges.note: An independent, Christ-centered liberal arts college known for its commitment to historic Christian faith, conservative values, and freedom from federal funding.

colleges.name: Pensacola Christian College
colleges.note: An independent Baptist college committed to the inerrancy of Scripture and historic fundamentalist doctrine.
